title: Standards: safetensors and ONNX
goal: Layout, metadata and safety properties of each, and which engines load them. Author the machine-readable profile (endpoints, auth, versions, request/response shapes, errors, rate-limit signals, streaming, capability tags) in config/ecosystem/ and test it offline against recorded fixtures. Facts come from official machine-readable specs or cited primary sources (no scraping that violates terms); every fact carries source, spec version, retrieved date and confidence.
